Screen checkConfirm in Vanderbilt's Oracle or UKG during a recorded demo: for each transaction, which documents are required and which are optional; where each document is filed; who decides when a course says If finance asks.

1 · Intro

When to use it.

Approvers send transactions back when the supporting document is missing, and payroll can only trust a change it can trace to a signed source. This course puts what every course says about documents into one table.

It is a draft. Where a course does not name a document yet, the table says so, and the owner for that area will confirm what is required.

Use this whenYou are about to submit a hire, a pay change, a termination, or a costing change and want to know what goes with it.

3 · Knowledge check

Check your understanding.

Three questions. You get feedback on each answer. All three right completes the course.

Q1The table shows To confirm for your transaction. What do you do?

Q2Where does a signed retention letter go?

Q3Which copy of a document do you file?

4 · Job aid

Keep it handy.

A one-page version of the steps and watch-outs. Print it or save it as a PDF.

HCM Academy job aid · Document Records & Reporting

What to attach: documents by transaction

Use when: You are about to submit a hire, a pay change, a termination, or a costing change and want to know what goes with it. · System: Overview

  1. Find your transaction in the table.
  2. Read the status.
    • Required: the course says you need it.
    • Attach: the course tells you to attach or file it.
    • If finance asks: your finance approver decides.
    • To confirm: no document is named yet.
  3. Get the final, signed copy before you start.
  4. Attach it to the transaction, and file it when the course says so.
  5. Say what the change is for in the comments.
  6. When the table says To confirm, ask before you submit.
